evidence_quotes.quote: Trend Analysis of Residential Properties Rental Values in Informal Settlements of Ibadan Metropolis
AROWOLO, Babatunde Emmanuel1*, OGUNTOKUN, Babajide Femi2, AYODELE, Oluwatobi Omoyemi3
This study analyzes trends in residential rental values in Ibadan Metropolis’s informal settlements from 2014 to 2024.
